dana_customer: Hey team, we have a customer report: streaming responses cut off after ~40-50s of idle, client reconnects, and they see partial output + duplicate billing for resumed chunks. Happening behind Cloudflare + ALB. Repro steps below.

anna_support: thanks @dana_customer — can you paste the exact curl + headers you used and a request_id if you have one? also tenant id. :eyes:

dana_customer: request_id=rc-20240319-7f9a, tenant=acme-inc. curl: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/stream' -d '{"model":"gpt-open-16k","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"status report"}]}'
```
Observed: initial partial output arrives, then silence ~45s, then client reconnects and receives a resumed chunk but server emits 401/403 for the reconnect and client retries -> duplicate partial tokens billed.

anna_support: got it. can you run tcpdump or a curl --trace-ascii to confirm whether the TCP connection is being half-closed by the ALB/CF? also, are you using Cloudflare Workers or just proxied DNS?

dana_customer: plain Cloudflare proxy (CDN + WAF) -> ALB (fronting origin). We ran curl --trace-ascii and saw FIN from the ALB side right before silence. no application error logs at origin for that request.

ben_sre: pinging oncall @eve-oncall. my hypothesis: ALB idle timeout (default 60s) + Cloudflare response buffering combo is causing an L7 half-close. If the client reconnects with an Authorization token that was cached at the origin proxy layer but invalidated at auth cache (token rotation), origin rejects reconnect -> 401 and client retries. That explains partial output + duplicate bill events.

carlos_eng: interesting — edge buffering can coalesce small chunks and then drop connection if idle probe triggers. two-parter: 1) ALB/NLB TCP idle vs ALB application idle mismatch; 2) auth cache window on our side + Cloudflare caching of Authorization header (if misconfigured) -> stale token on reconnect.

anna_support: @dana_customer can you try two quick workarounds to confirm: 1) set a short SSE heartbeat from client (or server) every 15s to keep ALB alive; 2) set Cloudflare origin keepalive to on and disable response buffering for that route. any logs after trying?

dana_customer: tried heartbeat + increased client poll interval for 3 minutes. After sending a lightweight SSE comment every 12s the stream stayed open. When we removed heartbeats it cut again. Also toggled Cloudflare "response buffering" off for the route and saw immediate improvement (no FINs).

ben_sre: that nails it — buffering + ALB idle probe. For the 401 on reconnect we saw a token refresh race in the app: the reconnecter was sending an old token while the app had already rotated keys for sessions. Carlos, can we add server-side logic to accept reconnects with short-lived reconnect tokens or use resumable session ids?

carlos_eng: quick mitigation: 1) add idempotency/resume token baked into SSE start frames so reconnects are matched server-side and resumes don't re-bill tokens; 2) ensure we advise customers to emit heartbeats if they sit idle > 30s behind ALBs. Long-term: improve our reconnect handling to accept a reconnect with same stream id + short-lived signature.

anna_support: filed support ticket S-2024-1987 with workaround steps and recommended Cloudflare + ALB settings. Noted customer applied temporary heartbeats + disabled buffering and is unblocked.

eve-oncall: adding config notes for runbook: 
- ALB: set idle timeout >= 300s for streaming routes
- Cloudflare: disable response buffering (or enable chunked transfer passthrough)
- Client: emit SSE comment / keepalive every 10-15s
- Server: return periodic 2s-space or comment chunk if no data
- Auth: add reconnect token/resume-id header doc and transient acceptance window

deploy-bot: deployment triggered for resume-token PoC branch #fix/stream-resume at 2024-03-19T18:12:00Z by carlos_eng :rocket:

dana_customer: thanks everyone — can we get a short KB with the exact Cloudflare/ALB toggles? I'll share with the customer ops team.

anna_support: will draft KB and paste config snippets. preliminary snippets:
```
# Cloudflare Page Rule / Worker: disable response buffering for /v1/chat/stream
fetch(request, { cf: { cacheTtl: 0, bypassCacheOnCookie: true, disableCache: true, responseBuffering: false }})
```
ALB: set IdleTimeoutSeconds=300 on the target group.

anna_support: marking ticket S-2024-1987 resolved for now (workarounds applied). Follow-up engineering task: STREAM-457 implement server-side resume tokens.

dana_customer: resolved from customer side, thanks :tada:
